content_sections.heading: About MMMUT
content_sections.text: Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology is a State Government funded university in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, formerly known as Madan Mohan Malaviya Engineering College. The University set up MMMUT Foundation as a Section-8 company to run its incubation centre. The selected candidates will be employees of the Foundation.

content_sections.heading: MMMUT CEO and Incubation Manager Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Preferred for both posts: Experience in entrepreneurship, the startup or incubation ecosystem, or in an incubator Experience in facility management, regulatory matters, finance etc. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Chief Executive Officer
content_sections.text: Secure Government funding, beginning with the MSME cluster development scheme and the technology upgradation scheme. Build the Centre into a self-sustaining institution that draws on the University's campus, laboratories and talent. Build the core organisation, structure and processes in line with the Foundation's purpose and vision. Establish the innovation and entrepreneurial ecosystem. Manage incubation, infrastructure and facilities, legal and compliance work, finance, administration, procurement, and IT and lab infrastructure. Raise and manage funds from Government schemes, industry, incubator funds and CSR. Attract grants (for example NITI Aayog, DST, NSTEDB, BIRAC, MeitY, MSME), pitch to angel investors and venture capitalists, and build revenue-generating services. Handle budgeting, reporting, audit and compliance with statutory rules and regulations. Curate programmes, events, engagement activities and marketing campaigns that promote entrepreneurship and the Foundation's visibility. Work with MMMUT faculty and students to incubate startups, steering technologies and IP towards commercialisation through mentoring and venture set-up. Frame and execute the long-term roadmap, business models and annual action plans in alignment with the Board. Send timely reports to the Board, funding agencies and stakeholders. Handle duties assigned by the Chairman, Member Secretary and Directors, and stay current with global developments in the incubator and startup ecosystem.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Incubation Manager
content_sections.text: Manage the daily operations of the MMMUT Foundation and its incubation facilities. Implement the annual action plan and operational instructions approved by the CEO and competent authority. Maintain records of startups, incubatees, applications, mentoring sessions, programmes, events and facility utilisation. Coordinate the use of office space, laboratories, equipment, meeting rooms and prototyping facilities. Ensure timely execution of assigned activities and maintain operational discipline. Identify promising entrepreneurs, student innovators, faculty innovators and technology-based startup teams.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection for both posts is direct, in three stages: Screening: A committee constituted by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor, Chairman, Board of Directors, MMMUT Foundation, checks all applications against the advertised criteria. Only candidates who meet the stated qualifications pass this stage. Shortlisting: A committee nominated by the Chairman shortlists candidates in a 1:3 ratio on merit. This committee sets the shortlisting criteria. Presentation: Shortlisted candidates make a presentation before the Board of Directors, MMMUT Foundation, which takes the final decision on appointment.

rows.condition: MMMUT Foundation, MMMUT Main Campus, Gorakhpur
Initially one year from the date of joining; may be extended by 1-2 years subject to performance review and the Foundation's requirements
No claim to permanency or continuation of job, however long the contract runs
No other gainful, commercial, business or professional activity, part-time or full-time, directly or indirectly
Six days a week, 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; work beyond office hours, including Saturdays and Sundays, may be required on event days or for incubator exigencies
Casual leave 14 days and Medical leave 10 days in a calendar year
One month before resignation, failing which the appointee is liable to pay in lieu; the experience certificate depends on serving the notice
Forthwith, without notice or compensation, if any information furnished by the candidate is found incorrect or misleading
The Foundation's information must be kept confidential during and after employment, and its rules on corrupt practices must be followed
The appointee bears personal tax liability; tax is deducted at source as per law
Holidays, code of conduct and similar matters are as decided from time to time by the Board of the MMMUT Foundation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MMMUT CEO and Incubation Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed on pages 5 to 7 of the official notification (PDF) . Add extra sheets wherever required. The University also directs candidates to its website for detailed instructions on filling in the form. Give details of your education, industrial experience, startup experience, present employment, consultancy projects, project output, honours and awards, and other significant contributions. Affix your latest colour passport photograph, then sign and date the form. List the testimonials you are attaching in the space provided at the end of the form. Mark the envelope or subject line "Application for the post of CEO / Incubation Manager, MMMUT Foundation". Send the application to: Registrar, Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, Kurnaghat Deoira Road, Gorakhpur (U.P.) 273010. Make sure it is received by the last date. Late applications will not be considered. Documents to send: Detailed resume Copies of educational certificates Copies of experience certificates Proof of age Copy of the last pay drawn certificate, if you fill in the last pay drawn section of the form

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised by MMMUT Foundation?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 01 Chief Executive Officer and 01 Incubation Manager. Both are direct appointments on contract.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the MMMUT CEO post?
faq.answer: The essential requirement is an M.Tech or MBA with 15 years of industry experience. Experience in an incubator, startup ecosystem, facility management, regulatory matters or finance is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. Can a B.Tech graduate apply for Incubation Manager?
faq.answer: Yes, a B.E or B.Tech with 03 years of industry experience meets the essential requirement for this post.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates applying for both posts should submit a separate application for each.

faq.question: Q5. Is the application submitted online?
faq.answer: The notice directs candidates to send their resume and certificates to the Registrar at Kurnaghat Deoira Road, Gorakhpur (U.P.) 273010. The envelope or subject line must read "Application for the post of CEO / Incubation Manager, MMMUT Foundation".

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract, and can it become permanent?
faq.answer: The initial term is one year and may be extended by 1-2 years. The contract gives no claim to permanency, however long it runs.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted in a 1:3 ratio on merit after screening. Shortlisted candidates then present before the Board of Directors, MMMUT Foundation, which makes the final decision.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours and leave?
faq.answer: The job runs six days a week from 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Staff get 14 days of Casual leave and 10 days of Medical leave in a calendar year.

faq.question: Q9. Can I keep another job or business alongside this post?
faq.answer: No. The appointee may not take up any other gainful, commercial, business or professional activity, whether part-time or full-time, directly or indirectly.
